title: Chicken Teriyaki Donburi
description: Pan-glazed teriyaki chicken thigh sliced over steamed rice with wilted greens, Japanese rice-bowl style.
steps: Sear the chicken skin-side down until golden, then flip and cook through.
Add the soy sauce, mirin, sugar and ginger, and simmer until glossy and thick.
Slice the chicken and serve over rice with wilted spinach and sesame seeds.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food Japanese recipe collection

notes: The glaze thickens fast once the sugar starts to caramelize — keep the heat moderate so it does not burn.
